name: brawler-brawl
note: brawler_auto: three bots fight stage 1 for 1200 ticks. The named state (positions, hit points, the hash of every body every tick) must match exactly on every host; the expects pin this run (repinned when standing bodies were kept fully apart and the bots began to flank an enemy in depth: game.overlaps, pairs of bodies still inside each other on any frame, stays 0). The control is one frame short.

webgpu.note: the same dual cart on romdev and Chromium against native WebGPU (state exact). vsGl 0.5 percent: GL and WebGPU draw the same picture (0.01 percent apart); the brick, asphalt and corrugated detail that differed by 4 to 10.6 percent was the engine lighting normal maps from the wrong side on WebGPU, fixed (findings/gl-webgpu-parity.md)
